title: ID0416631-DC/Si-D/DK[3AHqra] - CableCheck failure due to voltage not raising
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
CableCheck failure due to voltage not raising to 200V/500V → due to XD442 had loose connection
Solution:
Reconnect the cables from XD442

additional_info.subject: We have disabled plugs, not to confuse customers that the charger is working.
additional_info.body:
Just a note. We have disabled the two plugs so not to confuse the charging customers. Because it will show “Green” leds if we enable them.
You can of course activate the plugs if needed.

additional_info.subject: ID0416631-DC/Si-D/DK[3AHqra] - CableCheck failure due to voltage not raising CRM:00315002510
additional_info.body:
Dear Rasmus,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S3 170003353
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
3AHqra
Problem Description
: Charger is not able to build up voltage on DC1 and DC2
Troubleshooting
:
We made several tests and via DebugStation we could see that there was no voltage on the DC contactors but there was voltage on the converter but swinging (very strange?)
As such I believed it to be either the IMD or the Voltage transducer that was not reading the voltage correctly.
We checked the connector on the left side of the charger which is the responsible for the busbar measurements and plug out-plug in.
We also checked the QA44 and QA45 if they light up when starting the session → OK
Checked the XD12.1 responsible for transmitting the 24V to the DC contactors → OK
The problem then seems to come from after the QA44/45.
We checked in the backside the XD442 and found a loose connector → after putting the connections properly we were able to charge.
We found another problem with the modbus communication of the BC2 but after moving the cables it's operational again.
Please let me know if I can close the ticket.
For future reference, your case number is
0416631
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
